claim: Transfer chains were added to TransferDesk.jsx
Chains are stored in a list called SEED_CHAINS in TransferDesk.jsx
SEED_CHAINS exists alongside the transfers and stories lists
Each chain has a title, a short summary, and an ordered list of transfers
Every step after the first includes a label explaining how it follows from the previous step
A 'Funds' relationship generates a label such as 'Liverpool reinvest the X fee'
A 'Replaces' relationship generates a label such as 'Liverpool replace Ibrahima Konaté'
Custom wording can be written for any step instead of the generated label
A 'Linked Chains' section sits above the three columns on the board
The Linked Chains section renders one full-width row per chain
On narrow screens the chain steps stack vertically
Each step displays a step number
Each step displays its stage (Interest, In Talks, or Done)
Each step displays the reason it follows the previous step
Stages can differ within a chain so one step can be Done while the next is still In Talks
Each chain header shows how many of its moves are done, e.g. '1/2 done'
Chained transfers are removed from the three columns so nothing appears twice
Column counts went from 14/9/5 to 11/8/4 after chained transfers were removed
If any step matches the league filter or search, the whole chain stays visible
Steps that don't match the filter or search are faded rather than hidden
Searching also matches the chain's title and summary
The live feed can send chains in addition to transfers and stories
The format note at the top of the file documents the feed chain format
Feed chains are merged by ID the same way as transfers and stories
Steps pointing to unknown transfers are skipped
A chain with fewer than two valid steps is not shown
Transfers from a chain with fewer than two valid steps go back into the columns
A transfer can only be in one chain; if two chains list it, the first one keeps it
The file compiles without errors
A server render with real React produced the expected output
The layout has not been viewed in a browser and is untested
Nothing is committed

The Upamecano-as-Konaté's-replacement link comes from an existing note in the data
The Bremer-replacing-Upamecano-at-Bayern link is the agent's own guess from the Bayern centre-back story and was not reported by a source
